name: Plasencia (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided purple over green, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Plasencia (a castle between a pine and a mulberry on yellow, with the motto UT PLACEAT DEO ET HOMINIBUS).
history: The flag, which carries the arms at its centre, is defined as a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of two equal horizontal stripes, purple above and green below, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: Plasencia arms — castle between trees on yellow, with motto
